author: Animan
description:
Top 10 transfer student anime where the new kid is hiding something terrifying — government assassins, ancient dark overlords, and the world's most dangerous vampires all pretending to be ordinary students.
These aren't your average transfer students. From blue flame that deletes people to a man who ended actual wars and just wants to make friends — every MC on this list has a double life that would shatter their classmates' reality. Whether you want dark psychological writing or pure power fantasy, this list covers it all.
